resources.string: Three switches and you\'re done. Tap each one.
Lets the island appear on top of your screen.
Lets the island show music, calls and the notifications you choose.
Lets taps work on the whole island, including over the status bar.
Switch greyed out? Android blocks it for apps installed outside a store until you allow it.
Lagoon has no internet permission. Nothing it sees ever leaves your phone.
Which apps show on the island?
Pick the apps whose notifications pop up on the island. Music, calls, timers and charging always show.
Turn on all three to continue
